paragraphs.text: On the other side of May Ledbetter’s street you see a washing line with some baggy, crumpled clothes. It’s not a lot to work with, but you use your own clothes as stuffing, improvise a hat, and change your gait to a stooped shamble.
Nobody gives you a second look as you limp towards the southern exit from the village. The guards are still at their station, scrutinizing passers-by. But they are beginning to look bored.
Make a Hard Disguise roll. If you succeed, go to 146. If you fail, go to 139.
